audit.whatIsWrong: Chart rows 2, 5 and 6 read Singed while their own whys[] strings say 'Even at L3', 'You favour first item' and 'You favour 2+ items'.
audit.why: The packet chart is Tryndamere, Skill, Skill, Singed, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, and the singed__tryndamere mirror moved its whole chart to that same packet read. Row 3 already agrees.
audit.corrected: Rows 2 to Skill, 5 and 6 to Tryndamere, as matched full/content pairs with ratings and reasons.

audit.whatIsWrong: No numbers, and Insanity Potion is not treated as a spike at all.
audit.why: Fling 10/9.5/9/8.5/8 at only 125 range; Mega Adhesive 17/16/15/14/13 at 1000 range; Insanity Potion a flat 100s; Undying Rage 120/100/80. Insanity Potion is the real level-6 swing on his side because it turns Poison Trail into a Grievous Wounds source.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and mid; Insanity Potion's anti-heal written into late, whys[4] and dontsFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentions that Mega Adhesive grounds, or that Insanity Potion applies Grievous Wounds through Poison Trail. Both decide the matchup and neither appears anywhere.
audit.why: Riot's Mega Adhesive text: 'slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it' — grounding shuts off Spinning Slash, which is your only gap-closer and your only exit. Riot's Fling text roots only 'if the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive', so the root is conditional on the goo, not on Fling. Riot's Insanity Potion text makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which caps Bloodlust — your only sustain — for the potion's whole duration.
audit.corrected: Grounding stated as the reason to step off the goo before spinning; the Fling-into-goo condition stated; Grievous Wounds stated as a reason to heal before he drinks, not after.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Singed must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online — his Fling is up but so is Bloodlust. An even stage, and a check on not chasing him through the gas.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Fling's cooldown.
edits.after: Stridebreaker is your spike — crit bursts him faster than Poison Trail grinds you down.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Singed carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: you out-DPS and out-split him — take the free tower he concedes rather than duelling inside his poison.

edits.before: You favour L6 — Undying Rage negates his poison kill pressure and Bloodlust out-heals the ticks.
edits.after: You favour L6 — Undying Rage negates his poison, but heal before Insanity Potion caps Bloodlust.

edits.before: This is Singed's window: once he has Fling (E) plus Mega Adhesive he can flip you into his poison and your minions, so never chase him through the gas or you eat a Fling into a slow field and bleed out.
edits.after: This is Singed's window: Fling (E) plus Mega Adhesive flips you into his poison and your minions, and the goo grounds you so Spinning Slash will not fire — never chase him through the gas.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 belong to Singed: with Fling and Mega Adhesive he flips you into his Poison Trail and your creeps, so respect the flip and never facechase through the gas. Wait for Fling's cooldown to trade.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 belong to Singed: Fling flips you into Poison Trail and your creeps, and Mega Adhesive grounds your Spinning Slash, so step off the goo before you spin. Fling is 10s — trade on that.

edits.before: From 6 on you take over. Undying Rage means his poison can never finish you, and Bloodlust out-heals the ticks while you swing. With crit items you out-DPS and out-splitpush him — just don't get baited into chasing proxy-Singed through his gas.
edits.after: From 6 on you take over. Undying Rage means his poison can never finish you — but Insanity Potion puts Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail, so land Bloodlust before he drinks, not after. With crit items you out-DPS and out-split him; don't chase proxy-Singed through his gas.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. Bait it, then crit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Fling: 10s at rank 1 and only 125 range — he has to touch you. - Mega Adhesive grounds: Spinning Slash will not fire out of the goo, so step off it first. - Undying Rage: 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Track Singed's Fling: His flip. Bait it, then crit. When it is down — Crit him down.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive grounds you — Spinning Slash will not fire while you stand in the goo.

edits.before: His flip. Bait it, then crit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Fling is 10s at rank 1 and 125 range — bait it, then run your pattern.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Fling only roots you if you land in Mega Adhesive — watch the goo.

edits.before: That is Singed's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds — trade before he drinks.

notes: Two matchup-deciding facts were absent from every field: Mega Adhesive grounds (it turns off Spinning Slash, your only gap-closer AND your only exit), and Insanity Potion gives Poison Trail Grievous Wounds against your only sustain. Both now written in. Whether Mega Adhesive's grounding also prevents a Spinning Slash that is already in flight is not in the kit data — left alone, recorded in unverified.
